description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 66A (1) (a) Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Nagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Nagoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy created by resignation, which falls squarely under election-related matters and procedures.
